text: Extracts data from REST APIs, SQL databases, cloud storage, and Python data structures
quote: dlt extracts data from REST APIs, SQL databases, cloud storage, Python data structures, and many more

text: Automatically infers schemas and normalizes nested data during loading
quote: dlt infers schemas and data types, normalizes the data, and handles nested data structures.

text: Supports many destinations plus a custom-destination interface for building reverse ETL pipelines
quote: dlt supports a variety of popular destinations and has an interface to add custom destinations to create reverse ETL pipelines.

text: Supports schema and data contracts to govern how schema changes are handled
quote: dlt automates pipeline maintenance with incremental loading, schema evolution, and schema and data contracts.

text: Query loaded data with dataframe expressions, Ibis, or SQL and read results as records, Pandas, or Arrow tables
quote: You can build the query with data frame expressions, Ibis, or SQL. You can read the result as records, Pandas frames, or Arrow tables.

text: Pipelines are plain Python and run anywhere Python runs - laptops, notebooks, Airflow, Dagster, Lambda, containers
quote: Be it a Google Colab notebook, AWS Lambda function, an Airflow DAG, your local laptop, or an AI coding agent—dlt can be dropped in anywhere.

text: Installable with a local DuckDB destination for quick local testing
quote: pip install "dlt[duckdb]"        # local DuckDB destination

text: Provides a runnable example loading Python dictionaries into DuckDB and inspecting the resulting dataset
quote: let's load a list of Python dictionaries into DuckDB and inspect the created dataset

text: Includes a dbt runner that executes dbt as part of a pipeline, including creating a virtual environment on the fly
quote: You can run dbt with dlt by using the dbt runner. The dbt runner: Can create a virtual environment for dbt on the fly...

text: LanceDB destination loads data into a multimodal vector store for similarity search
quote: It allows you to store data objects and perform similarity searches over them. This destination helps you load data into LanceDB from dlt resources.

text: Official CLI can create, add, inspect, and deploy dlt pipelines
quote: Creates, adds, inspects and deploys dlt pipelines.

text: Single `dlthub deploy` command deploys pipelines; decorator-based API lets you schedule, refresh, backfill and observe runs
quote: Deploy your pipelines with a single `dlthub deploy` command. Schedule, refresh, backfill, and observe runs with a familiar decorator-based Python API.

text: dltHub AI Harness gives coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) skills, rules and MCP servers to build and deploy production pipelines on managed infra
quote: The dltHub AI Harness is a set of skills, rules, and MCP servers that teach a general-purpose coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex) how to build production-grade pipelines, deploy and run them on dltHub managed infrastructure.

text: dltHub CLI and web UI let you monitor pipeline health, inspect logs, and diagnose failures
quote: Use the dltHub CLI and the Web UI at app.dlthub.com to monitor pipeline health, inspect logs, and diagnose failures.

text: dbt model generator analyzes the pipeline schema and auto-generates staging and fact dbt models
quote: It analyzes the pipeline schema and automatically generates staging and fact dbt models.

text: AI assistants can be turned into expert dlt pipeline developers across 11,200+ REST API data sources
quote: we turn AI assistants into expert dlt pipeline developers across over 11,200 REST API data sources.

text: Supports merge/upsert loading using merge_key or primary_key, deduplicating records at the destination
quote: Merge: Merges new data into the destination using merge_key and/or deduplicates/upserts new data using primary_key.

text: Offers a service that migrates existing pipelines onto dltHub-managed infrastructure
quote: Migration to dltHub included

text: Automatically infers the initial schema on first run and adapts pipelines when upstream schemas change
quote: dlt automatically infers the initial schema for your first pipeline run... dlt handles these schema changes, enabling you to adapt to changes without losing velocity.

text: Lets you switch destinations without modifying pipeline code
quote: This approach is especially useful when switching between destinations without modifying the actual pipeline code.

text: Provides a collection of verified sources developed and maintained by the dlt team and community
quote: Choose from our collection of verified sources, developed and maintained by the dlt team and community.

text: REST API source uses declarative configuration to define endpoints, relationships, pagination, and authentication
quote: Using a declarative configuration, you can define: the API endpoints to pull data from, their relationships, how to handle pagination, authentication.

text: Supports all SQLAlchemy dialects (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, Oracle, MSSQL, MariaDB, DB2, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.) as sources
quote: We support all SQLAlchemy dialects... including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MariaDB, IBM DB2 and Informix, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift...

text: dlt-init-openapi generates dlt pipelines directly from any OpenAPI 3.x spec into any destination
quote: dlt-init-openapi generates code from an OpenAPI spec that you can use to extract data from a rest_api into any destination

text: Engineers can ship production pipelines with agents doing the work on dltHub-run infra, with every run logged and auditable
quote: Any engineer on your team can ship production data, with agents doing the work on infra we run. Every run is logged and auditable.

text: Incremental loading loads only new or changed data, skipping records already loaded
quote: Incremental loading is the act of loading only new or changed data and not old records that we have already loaded.

text: SQL Database source can use SQLAlchemy, PyArrow, pandas, or ConnectorX as loading backends
quote: The SQL Database verified source loads data to your specified destination using one of the following backends: SQLAlchemy, PyArrow, pandas, or ConnectorX.

text: Loads JSONL, CSV, and Parquet files from cloud storage, SFTP, or local filesystem
quote: load data files like JSONL, CSV, and Parquet from either Cloud Storage (e.g., AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Google Drive, Azure Blob Storage), a remote (SFTP), or a local file system

text: Loads data from SQL databases (Postgres, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, DB2, etc.) into any dlt-compatible destination
quote: use dlt to load data from a SQL Database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, IBM DB2, etc.) into any dlt-compatible destination

text: GitHub Actions guide lets you run pipelines headlessly in CI with a generous free tier
quote: try the GitHub Actions guide which has a generous free tier for anyone using GitHub

text: Playground workspace runs a sample pipeline and launches a coding agent ready to build your own source
quote: runs a sample pipeline in your personal Playground workspace, and launches your coding agent ready to build your own source

text: MCP server exposes tools to inspect, debug, and manage dlt pipelines, secrets, schemas, and runs
quote: MCP server exposing tools for inspecting, debugging, and managing dlt pipelines, secrets, schemas, and runs in a dlt workspace.

text: Can generate a Marimo notebook file with charts from Ibis queries and an analysis plan
quote: Reads chart specs with ibis queries and altair code from analysis_plan.md, assembles a marimo Python file, validates, and launches.

text: Full load mode replaces the entire destination dataset with the current run's output
quote: Full load: replaces the destination dataset with whatever the source produced on this run.

text: Open-source Python library for loading messy data sources into well-structured datasets
quote: dlt is an open-source Python library that loads data from various, often messy data sources into well-structured datasets.

text: Claims 8000+ source connectors, positioned as built for LLM use cases
quote: dlt is an open-source Python library that loads data from various sources into well-structured datasets. Built for LLMs with 8000+ source connectors.

text: Provides end-to-end cross-database compatibility for dlt→dbt pipelines
quote: End-to-end cross-db compatibility for dlt→dbt pipelines.

text: Can schedule lineage-aware pipeline runs driven by agents, entirely in Python
quote: Schedule lineage-aware pipeline runs with agents, all in Python

text: A developer with a coding agent can build and operate ingestion, transformations, quality checks, and data apps end-to-end without managing infrastructure
quote: A developer or analyst comfortable with Python and a coding agent can build and operate ingestion, transformations, quality checks, and data apps end-to-end without managing infrastructure.

text: Teams can schedule, backfill, and chain their pipelines using dltHub
quote: teams schedule, backfill, and chain their pipelines with dltHub.

text: Provides a migration service moving customers off Fivetran, Airbyte, Informatica, or hand-rolled Python onto dlt
quote: Moving off Fivetran, Airbyte, Informatica, or hand-rolled Python. Our engineers run the migration and hand you back pipelines running in production.
